bullets: US futures up (Nasdaq +0.7%, S&P +0.3%) after strong tech earnings restored AI-trade confidence; Asia mixed, Europe higher.
Brent near $110 on Strait of Hormuz supply fears, keeping inflation and yield pressure on risk assets.
US 10Y yield ~5.10%; French-German spread near 15-yr high (~159bps) signals European sovereign stress.
Heavy earnings day: Meta, Tesla, IBM, Philip Morris report; weekly EIA crude inventories also due.
